## Advising & Mentoring

David chairs dissertation committees for doctoral students in the Education Policy program and regularly serves as a committee member for students in Public Policy, Economics, and Measurement, Statistics, and Evaluation. He also mentors junior faculty and postdoctoral fellows within the department.

Prospective students interested in teacher labor markets, causal inference in education, or educator diversity are welcome to reach out — see the [Contact](index.qmd) section on the home page.
